description: Check up to 100 IP addresses in one call for VPN, proxy, Tor exit, relay, hosting or CDN membership, using the VPN & Proxy Detection API's native batch endpoint. Each successful row carries the same fields as `vpn_proxy_detection` (classification, provider, confidence, risk_score, is_* flags, ASN, reason codes); inputs the API rejects, such as reserved addresses, come back as ok=false rows with an error code. Detection data is IPv4-first: IPv6 addresses are accepted but most return unknown. Duplicate inputs are looked up once. Costs 1 VPN & Proxy Detection API credit per IP successfully looked up; rejected rows are not charged. Requires a Starter or higher VPN & Proxy Detection plan. Use this whenever you have 2 or more IPs; split lists longer than 100 client-side.

ip_addresses.description: IP addresses to classify (max 100 per call; 1 credit per IP successfully looked up).

name: bulk_vpn_proxy_detection
